items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC-1..AC-10 each map to a unit or E2E test (match, provider, click guard, hook, probe, 106 spec); web-link code untouched.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Probe failure/5xx/network/truncated window fail toward opening the Viewer (server remains the gate); stale probe results dropped; unresolvable target and not-ready project are no-ops.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Only the Viewer opens; provider never calls window.open (test); http(s)-only web handler unchanged; no server change; outside paths only via the existing session-file route; button/drag/multi-click guards.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Outcome-based tests incl. error paths; real-browser E2E over the real pty/routes for the four required cases plus guard and Pixel-5 touch scroll/tap.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Provider scans only the hovered logical line (capped at 40 rows); one probe per outside click (double scan disclosed).

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New files 63-97 lines; EmbeddedTerminal.tsx at its 311 baseline (no ratchet), TaskDetailPage 537 < 560; no inline suppressions, no hard-coded colours (token classes).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format changed; reads only terminal buffer text and an existing route's status/detail.
